notes.title: Steam Update Crash Fix #2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

The crashes due to the last Steam Client updates were finally fixed. Many thanks for YoYo Games Staff for this.
Remember that you need to update it so these fixes can take effect.

If you downloaded the beta temporary workaround, you must opt-out of this or you will not be able to unlock any Steam Achievements with it.

To opt-out of the beta:

- Right click on the game in Library. 
- Go to Properties. 
- Click in the Beta tab and select the "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs". 
- Now just update and play it. Yay! XD 


By the way, now that these crash issues were fixed, Porradaria 2: Pagode of the Night will be released with Steam Achievements as well. However, the release date will be a bit more delayed.

Also don't forget that Porradaria 3: Final Dream is awaiting for your "Yes, please" or "No, thanks" votes on Steam Greenlight. 

Thanks for your ever support, my work is for you! 

Kind regards, 
Alysson L. Neto

notes.title: Steam Update Crash Fix
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The last Steam Update caused most games developed with Game Maker: Studio to crash even before being opened. Porradaria Upgrade was no exception.
Unfortunately, this is something that's out of my hands to fix, but I managed to create a workaround for this.

To play Porradaria Upgrade with this lame fix, just opt-in in the beta.

- Right click on the game in Library.
- Go to Properties.
- Click in the Beta tab and select the "Steam Crash Lame Fix".
- Now just update and play it. Yay! XD

With this workaround you can play Porradaria Upgrade, gather Steam cards, save/load your game with the Steam Cloud, but can't unlock Steam Achievements.

This is just a lame fix. As I said before, fixing this issue is something out of my hands and must be done at Valve and YoYo Games side. I already contacted them and they are already working on this.
As soon as they fix this issue, I will notify you.

Thanks for your ever support, my work is for you!

Kind regards,
Alysson L. Neto
